summary.building: All-current Pons stock launch support and the maximum safely executable stock-raffle set
summary.topRisk: An immutable raffle can permanently promise a stock route that no longer quotes or executes
summary.mustDecideFirst: Freeze only assets whose exact stock output is covered by a passing route or reserved inventory
summary.watchOutFor: The current deployed raffle generation accepts at most 16 stock rewards

risks.title: Stale launch inventory
risks.detail: A hand-maintained UI list silently hides valid factory-approved pairs.

risks.title: Ticker identity collision
risks.detail: Address and factory approval, not a display ticker, must identify the pair asset.

risks.title: Upgradeable stock implementation
risks.detail: One beacon upgrade can change behavior for every immutable stock payout.

risks.title: Restricted replenishment
risks.detail: Reserve acquisition depends on jurisdiction and authorized market access.

risks.title: Immutable dead route
risks.detail: An unexecutable stock route permanently degrades the affected raffle slots.

risks.title: Guard and adapter pool mismatch
risks.detail: A fee-tier mismatch prices a different pool from the one used for execution.

risks.title: Time-dependent route readiness
risks.detail: Liquidity and TWAP readiness must be rechecked at the real prize size before deployment.

preCodingDecisions.title: Raffle route ceiling
preCodingDecisions.detail: Raise both immutable raffle implementations from 16 to 64 stock rewards in a new generation.

preCodingDecisions.title: Availability rule
preCodingDecisions.detail: Accept a stock when exact output is covered by a passing market route or reserved protocol inventory.

requirementsCorrections.detail: Pons pair approval proves launch support, not the existence of a WETH/stock pool.
Raffle creation must reserve stock or pass a live route preflight at maximum slot size.
The deployed raffle generation supports only 16 stock routes while 26 are executable and 53 must be representable.
Stock assets, adapters, guards, and route bytes are frozen for each raffle.
